connectionReference.description: Connects to Office 365 Outlook for reading incoming emails and sending auto-replies
setupInstructions: 1. In Copilot Studio, go to Settings > Connections
2. Click 'Add connection' and search for 'Office 365 Outlook'
3. Sign in with the Microsoft 365 account that owns the mailbox to monitor
6. If monitoring a shared mailbox, enter the shared mailbox address in settings.json under emailSettings.monitoring
